pill-words.purpose: One line inside the pill; once it fills it scrolls, and the oldest words fade out at the left edge.

bubble-words.purpose: Up to six lines in the bubble above, then it scrolls up a line at a time.

app-label.purpose: Sidebar items, control labels, row titles, button text.

app-body.purpose: Running text and text field values.

app-transcript.purpose: The popover's history rows, with 4 pt extra line spacing.

app-detail.purpose: Row descriptions, helper text, field messages.

shadows.name: rim-light
shadows.value: 1.2pt line of ivory light, +0.95pt where voice lands; halo 2.6pt outward, 3.0pt on hover, up to about 5.65pt during the collapse; drawn by a shader, not a shadow

shadows.name: word-glow
shadows.purpose: Brief glow on changed words: 0.6 for words cleanup inserts, 0.21 for words it changes, 0.3 for a live preview revision, 0.85 as the release light passes; decays with a 0.32s time constant.

shadows.name: waveform-glow
shadows.purpose: Glow around the waveform in the pill.

shadows.name: window-material
shadows.value: app-window over macOS behind-window material (NSVisualEffectView, .underWindowBackground); system blur, no fixed radius; 1px app-line-rule outline inside the edge; system window shadow
shadows.purpose: The one shell for the settings window, the popover and the first-run window.

shadows.name: lit-edge-resting
shadows.value: 1px line on the top edge: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,246,234,0), #FFF6EA 50%, rgba(255,246,234,0)); inset 16pt from each end on shells, 14pt on fields
shadows.purpose: Lit top edge on every floating panel: the window, the popover, the first-run window, a focused text field or shortcut recorder.

shadows.name: lit-edge-live-rim
shadows.value: 1.2px line on the top edge: linear-gradient(90deg) of #FFE4B8, #FFF6EA, #FFCFA0, #FFEBD2, the four tones repeating three times
shadows.purpose: The lit top edge while the mic is live; the same four tones as the pill's rim.

shadows.name: lit-edge-live-halo
shadows.value: 2.6px band of the live rim's gradient, opacity 0.7, filter: blur(4px); along and below the edge, never outward
shadows.purpose: The glow under the live rim.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.value: outline: 2px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.6) Light / rgba(255,228,184,0.85) Dark; outline-offset: 1px
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on any control that opts in: a 2pt ring 1pt outside its edge, no blur.

shadows.name: toggle-knob
shadows.purpose: The only small shadow inside the shell, under the toggle knob.

shadows.name: segment-selected
shadows.purpose: Under the selected segment of a segmented control; the same shadow as the toggle knob.

shadows.name: status-live-glow
shadows.purpose: Glow around the listening status dot.

motion.name: size-change
motion.purpose: Pill growing with words, shrinking after cleanup.

motion.name: words-slide
motion.purpose: Words sliding into their cleaned-up place.

motion.name: leave
motion.purpose: Removed words leaving; bubble merging back.

motion.name: split
motion.purpose: Retry bubble splitting off the right of the pill.

motion.name: shake
motion.purpose: Retry bubble shaking once when a retry fails again.

motion.name: bubble-above-blur
motion.purpose: Blur of the bubble above as it splits and merges.

motion.name: release-light
motion.purpose: Rim light travelling inward to the centre line on release.

motion.name: green-hold
motion.purpose: Mint line holding before the collapse.

motion.name: collapse
motion.value: 340ms, swell 1.08 first (words 1.05), height leads width by 80ms, fade from 120ms

motion.name: appear
motion.purpose: Pill growing from a point, through a 1.2pt line, to full height.

motion.name: hide
motion.purpose: Pill leaving when hidden without a paste.

motion.name: reduce-motion-fade
motion.purpose: Retry bubble fading in and out in place when Reduce Motion is on.

motion.name: snap
motion.purpose: App: hover, press, the toggle and the pane cross-fade (GlassTheme.snap).

components.name: Pill, listening

components.name: Pill, pasted

components.name: Bubble above

components.name: Retry bubble

components.css: .ds-row { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-pill-small { width: 120px; height: 28px; border-radius: 14px; background: #0E0F13; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.2px #FFE4B8, 0 0 2.6px 1px rgba(255,228,184,0.55); } .ds-retry { width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: #0E0F13; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.2px #FFE4B8; display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 0.16s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-retry svg { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.16s; } .ds-retry:hover, .ds-retry:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px #FFF6EA, 0 0 3px 1px rgba(255,238,214,0.7); outline: none; } .ds-retry:hover svg, .ds-retry:focus-visible svg { opacity: 1; } .ds-retry:active { transform: scale(1.015, 1.03); }

components.name: Primary button

components.name: Text field

components.name: Toggle

narrative.overview:
Fluidity shows one thing on screen: a small near-black pill, docked 12 pt above the bottom of the visible screen area, so above the Dock when the Dock is shown, that appears only while you dictate. Its edge is a thin ring of ivory light that brightens, drifts and blooms with your voice. Your words appear inside the pill, or in a bubble that splits off above it. When you let go, the light travels inward and becomes one line through the centre while the text is cleaned up. When the paste lands, the line turns mint green, holds for 260 ms, and the pill collapses and is gone.

The shape and motion come from the iPhone's Dynamic Island. The pill's sizes and springs, and the way the bubble splits off and merges back, all use values read from SpringBoard, so it moves like a system part of the Mac rather than an app's window. The body stays the same near-black on any background, and the light is the only colour.

The app around the pill, its settings window, menu bar popover and first-run window, follows the direction the Figma file names "Glass". Its shell is macOS's own translucent material, so it floats over other apps the way the pill does, and its only colour is light caught on edges: a 1 pt lit top edge on every floating panel that brightens to the pill's ivory rim while the mic is live. Type, palette, density, controls and the lit top edge are Fluidity's own; each control still reports to VoiceOver as the macOS control for its job.
keyCharacteristics: One near-black capsule; colour comes only from the light around its edge.
Ivory light by default; mint for a paste that landed, amber for a problem, soft orange for a retry that failed again.
Dynamic Island sizes, springs and splitting, not app-style easing.
On screen only while dictating, then it collapses and disappears.
dos: Do keep the pill and every bubble `pill-body` on every background; colour lives only in the light.
Do use the Dynamic Island springs above for every size, position and merge change.
Do switch from ivory to mint at once when a paste lands, and hold green for 260 ms.
Do scale any distance taken from the Dynamic Island by the pill's height ÷ 36.67.
Do honour Reduce Motion exactly as described above.
Do build the shell of the window, the popover and the first-run window from one material: `app-window` over macOS's behind-window material, with no fixed blur.
Do draw the lit top edge on floating panels only: the window, the popover, the first-run window, a focused text field or shortcut recorder.
Do make every control a capsule, except history rows (10 pt corners) and the rules editor and keycaps (8 pt).
Do make every control the app draws report to VoiceOver as the native control for its job.
Do opt every focusable control into the Glass focus ring; the system ring is off.
Do keep at most one filled button per window.
donts: Don't use the Ember, Rose quartz or Tide rim colours; Ivory is the only rim colour set.
Don't add a drop shadow, a border or a fill colour to the pill.
Don't widen the rim past 1.2 pt plus 0.95 pt of voice, or its halo past 3 pt outside the collapse.
Don't scale or bounce the pill to say it can't hear you; pulse the light instead.
Don't keep the pill on screen when the user isn't dictating.
Don't blend ivory into mint; switch at once. Amber eases in over 0.28 s and orange over 0.06 s, and no change may pass through grey.
Don't put a blurred or frosted panel inside the shell; raised panels are plain fills.
Don't draw the lit top edge on rows, raised panels, buttons, the sidebar or the rules editor.
Don't set secondary text in a neutral grey; use `app-text-secondary`.
Don't use `app-state-done-light` for text; at 4.11:1 it colours icons only.
Don't add another colour of light; ivory is the only light, and mint and amber appear only for states.
Don't fade the lit top edge or the status dot between ivory and a state colour; switch at once.
Don't add a drop shadow of your own; the system window shadow is the only one.
